keyPoints: Tatva (element) wo shuddh padarth hai jo kisi bhi vidhi se saral padarthon me nahi toda ja sakta — jaise loha, oxygen, sona aur carbon.
Yogik (compound) do ya zyada tatvon ka rasayanik mel hai — paani hydrogen aur oxygen ka yogik hai, namak sodium aur chlorine ka.
Mishran (mixture) me padarth bina rasayanik mel ke mile hote hain — hawa, sharbat aur mitti mishran ke udaharan hain.
Yogik ke gun uske tatvon se bilkul alag hote hain (hydrogen jalta hai, oxygen jalne me madad karti hai, par paani aag bujhata hai); mishran me har ghatak apne gun banaye rakhta hai.
Yogik ko sirf rasayanik vidhi se toda ja sakta hai, jabki mishran ko bhautik vidhi — chhanna, fatekna, chumbak — se alag kiya ja sakta hai.
Mishran samgun (uniform) bhi ho sakta hai jaise namak-paani ka vilayan, aur vishamgun bhi jaise ret-paani ka mishran.
Aam galti: hawa ko yogik samajhna; hawa nitrogen, oxygen aadi gas ka mishran hai, unme koi rasayanik mel nahi hua hai.

title: Tatva, Yogik aur Mishran
